notes.title: 6 New Cabinets, New Hub Map, & Events - Client Update 8/10/2019
notes.content:
Today's update brings 6 new cabinet models along with a new map that test out improvements to the upcoming Nodes feature.

[h1][b]6 New Cabinets Models[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/46be2d15b198f803972a73fda5e25250e937dce2.jpg[/img]
[b]From left to right:[/b] Moon Kiosk, VRCade, Triple Force, Moon Kiosk Wide, Podium, Monolith.

Add some more variety to your arcades with these stylish new cabinet models. :)  The Monolith and Triple Force cabinets are animated.  The Monolith The Triple Force also allows you to change which image channel is used on it using Skins.  The VRCade cabinet flashes colors in response to your system audio levels, and also allows you to toggle the VR gear on the shelf on/off using Body Groups.  It was requested by AArcade user FunkyPixie, who also graciously donated $45 dollars with his request.  (Thank you FunkyPixie for the support!)

Also, a bug has been fixed that might have caused the previous set of new cabinet models to be missing from your list in the past.  So you might notice even more new cabinets on your list than these 6.

[h1][b]New Hub Map & Upcoming Nodes Feature[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/3628953406b0bf411f4fac8a5cdebece7fcae6e0.jpg[/img]
This new map looks strange, but that's because it [b]IS[/b] strange.  Hub maps are designed to be used with an upcoming feature called Nodes.  Nodes are simple physical clusters of items & objects that an instance of can be spawned into any of your worlds.  Hub maps, such as the new map [b]hub_construct[/b], are like node factories.  They are where you create, edit, & save your nodes.

Nodes are an upcoming feature that are not fully implemented just yet, but are already partially working for users to start testing out.  Full instructions for nodes will come in a few weeks when they are completed, but for now the main thing to know is that pulling the leaver next to a node is how you manage them.  And also that nodes show up in your library like regular items.  If you need help in the mean time, the Twitch or the Discord are the best places to get live chat with AArcade users.

[h1][b]AArcade Creators Meetup & Arcade Tours[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/04bda51a9cfe028db16184473bb154c9480dceb4.jpg[/img]
Every 2 weeks AArcade users who create addon content using hard-mode tools (like Hammer, Blender, Photoshop, etc.) and I meet in an AArcade world where screenshots of the stuff we are working on are archived onto the walls.  We talk about what people have been working on lately, check out the screenshots together that people have shared, and discuss upcoming features & development of AArcade.  This is called the AArcade Creator's Meetup, and here is the Twitch VoD of the last one we had on Aug. 3rd: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/462872103

After this event, we all go and meetup with other AArcade users to tour multiplayer arcades together.  Often the person who created the arcades we visit are in there with us, guiding us around and telling us about what we're looking at.  This is called the Arcade Tours event, and here's the Twitch VoD of the arcades we toured last time on Aug. 3rd: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/462873799

If you'd like to take part in these live events, or just want to connect with the AArcade community, you can find us often at the Anarchy Arcade Twitch channel (twitch.tv/AnarchyArcade), or always in our Discord: https://discord.gg/9FSCDuJ

I'll see you around the metaverse!  Party on!

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added 6 new cabinet models: Triple Force, Podium, Moon Kiosk & Moon Kiosk Wide, Monolith, and VRCade.
[*] Added the new map hub_construct for building & testing out the upcoming Nodes feature.
[*] Added a new node style named Loft.  It's like a floor node, but taller.
[*] Fixed a bug w/ nodes that could cause nodes to spawn in duplicate objects.
[*] Fixed a bug w/ nodes that could cause incorrect object orientations when saving.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some people not to get new cabinets added to their default library in AArcade updates.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Body Groups to appear blank on cabinet models.[/list]

[b]NOTE:[/b] The new map, [b]hub_construct[/b], may not appear on your list if you have disabled detecting maps at AArcade startup.  You could go to Main Menu > Settings > Import tab > Maps button in this case to detect it.

notes.title: Quick Spawn & Paste - Client Update 8/2/2019

Greetings arcaders!  Today's small update will help you add new things to your library faster.  You can now [b]CTRL+V[/b] paste a URL while in walking-around mode without bringing up any menu at all.  This update also adds a new Quick Spawn Items option to the UI tab that lets you bypass the properties menu when adding new items.

notes.title: Body, Skin, & Vehicles - Client Update 7/25/2019
notes.content:
A Skin is the material used to give an object its looks & colors.  Body Groups allow objects to have alternative and/or optional 3D parts attached to them.  Today's AArcade update adds support for both Body Groups & Skins to the Transform menu!

[h1][b]Body Groups[/b][/h1]
If a model supports body groups, they'll be listed in the new Body Groups tab of the Transform menu.  Each body group has its own name & slider.  Some body groups can just be turned off/on, while others might have many different values to choose from!  Note that most models do not utilize body groups.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/fdf554f737d33e25445f4651eae9e5c9e0d43680.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Skins[/b][/h1]
If a model supports skins, they'll be listed in the new Skins tab of the Transform menu.  Skins only impact the look & color of a model.  Note that most models do not utilize extra skins.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/3148cf66c5e501159243fb4ce66c3e65233548ab.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Visual Vehicle Override[/b][/h1]
We've always been able to spawn the default HL2 Air Boat, but its looks are so basic & boring.  Today's update lets us override the air boat's visual model with **any** of our own custom addon models.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/d3e04cad15fdcb7be149b608792b55cf3b835c6a.jpg[/img]

Only the visual model is replaced with our own static addon model, not the behavior of the air boat, but even this is a big step up from the ugly air boat. 
 This feature takes a couple steps to setup, but is worth it especially for your arcades in very large maps!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/886804ed510027a282b000f5bd813121a22a1d82.jpg[/img]

First, you have to spawn your model into the world.  Next, you middle-click on it, choose Advanced, then Flag As Vehicle.  After that, it'll appear on the new Settings > Vehicle tab.

The Vehicle tab allows you to spawn your vehicle, but also allows you to adjust the camera position when riding in your vehicle, as well as adjust the offset & rotation of the visual model you are overriding the air boat with.  Hover over any of the sliders for in-game help text about what they do.

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added support for Body Groups & Skins.  (Also added them to the Transform Menu while in Object Placement Mode.)
[*] Added Mouse Wheel Up / Down to be enter/exit third person mode & camera zoom.  (Only when weapons are disabled, otherwise it is switch weapons like normal.)
[*] Added a Visual Vehicle Override system so that we can drive better vehicles than just the default HL2 Air Boat.
[*] Added Flag As Vehicle and Unflag As Vehicle buttons to the Object Properties menu.  Flagging an object's model as a vehicle adds it to the new Settings > Vehicle tab.
[*] Added a Vehicle tab to the Settings menu.  It will only be useful after you've flagged some of your addon props as vehicles.  It is where you can adjust the camera & model overrides for each vehicle model you flag.
[*] Added Vehicle Menu and Vehicle Remove All Spawned to the Commands tab.  Also renamed the Air Boat command to Vehicle Spawn.
[*] Added Camera Vertical to the Settings > Camera tab.  It lets you control the vertical offset of the camera while in 3rd person mode.
[*] Added help text when hovering over tab icons in the Tab Menu.
[*] Added a Close Task and Close All Tasks buttons to the Commands tab.  Useful for people who have Auto-Close Tasks turned off.
[*] Added various console variables & commands associated with the new vehicle system: vehicle_menu, setvehiclemodel, air_boat_model, air_boat_offset, air_boat_angles, vehicle_eye_offset.
[*] Improved addon model compatibility & stability.  (ie. Fixed a crash bug that lots of models had.)
[*] Improved range of motion of the values on the Settings > Camera tab.
[*] Improved the Commands tab by renaming Toggle Libretro, Toggle Mute, and Stop Sounds to Libretro Auto-Play Toggle, Sound Mute Toggle, and Sound Stop respectively in order to make them easier to find in the list.
[*] Fixed various issues with saving new nodes. (The rotation bug with objects positioned at odd angles is still an issue though.)
[*] Fixed the togglephysics command to show up in console search & auto-complete.[/list]

notes.title: Action Bar - Client Update 7/12/2019
notes.content:
Greetings!  Today's update adds an RPG-style Action Bar that is customizable from the F7 Commands tab, and also addresses some issues with the launcher that users reported.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/26a4e5aad4a94fc7138bf014d39f1feae09fbed7.jpg[/img]

Note that when you have All Guns On enabled, keyboard buttons 1-5 are occupied by weapon slots.  So be sure to bind your All Guns Off to a keyboard button higher than 5.

At 11:47AM Pacific I pushed a hotfix to include the updated launcher assets.

notes.title: Transfer Menu - Client Update 7/6/2019
notes.content:
Good morning arcaders!  Today's small update focuses on improving the multiplayer experience for guests.

[h1][b]Transfers Tab[/b][/h1]
A Transfers tab has been added to the Tab Menu that shows you what props are still downloading when connected to a multiplayer server as a guest.

[h1][b]Newly Downloaded Addon Props[/b][/h1]
Newly downloaded props now spawn into the world more reliably & with proper collisions.  No more having to rejoin!

As always, more updates are around the corner.  Be excellent to each other, and party on, dudes!

[h1][b]Note About ReShade Settings[/b][/h1]
Today's update might slightly impact your ReShade settings, specifically it might switch your active preset back to DefaultPreset.ini and change your ReShade shortcut key back to Shift + Scroll Lock in AArcade.  I apologize for this minor inconvenience and should have zero-impact updates soon!  In the mean time, you could just hit Shift + Scroll Lock and change back to your preferred presets & shortcut keys.

[h1][b]Note About Launcher Bugs[/b][/h1]
Just a PSA about 2 bugs in the current launcher in case they are impacting you.  
 I should have these fixed by next week, but if they are impacting you in the mean time, here's some info on them & workarounds.

First, the launcher is sometimes reverting to DISABLED on all options for some users.  The result is missing addon & workshop content in-game.  If this impacts you, you can right-click on AArcade in your Steam Library, choose Properties, and then set your Launch Options to have -config in them.  This will cause the launcher to display itself the next time you launch AArcade for you to confirm your options are ENABLED as they should be - restoring the addon & workshop content in-game.

Second, a handful of users report their anti-virus settings delete arcade_launcher.exe as soon as Steam tries to downloaded it - leaving Steam in an endless downloading loop.  If this impacts you, users report that adjusting their anti-virus settings or adding an exception for arcade_launcher.exe resolves their issue.

So keep an eye out for an improved launcher in next week's update to resolve these bugs, and I'll see you guys next time!

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Improved reliability of keyboard & mouse wheel input.  (Click on the UI to focus the UI, or click on the web page / content to focus on it instead.)
[*] Added the console command nodraw_shortcuts 0. When set to 1, all of the stuff you spawned will be invisible. Useful for taking comparison screenshots of empty arcades vs full arcades. (If set to 2 AND Stereo Rendering is enabled, it instead shows the left view as the blank vanilla map, and the right view as the populated map.)
[*] Increased the supported AI Node limit from 1500 to 2000.  (Increasing compatibility with maps that already expect a higher limit.)
[*] Improved AArcade's material adoption to detect $normalmap, $normalmap2, and $texture2 channels.
[*] Added a Transfers tab to the Tab Menu.  It will show you what addon content is still transferring, and which has already spawned in.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused addon models to not spawn in until the 2nd time that the guest joined.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused addon models to be non-collide the first time that the client connected.
[*] Improved item matching as a guest in MP servers by reducing false-positive matches.
[*] Improved the (F5) Screenshot Menu to be able to scroll, if needed.
[*] Improved drag & drop support slightly so that dropping multiple MDL files into AArcade as the same time is supported.[/list]

[b]NOTE[/b]
At 7:26AM Pacific time I pushed a hotfix so that individual props that are drag & dropped onto AArcade's window still spawn correctly.

notes.title: Happy Accidents - Client Update 6/9/2019
notes.content:
Greetings!  Today's update adds a pretty substantial [b]paint[/b] feature to AArcade!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/6b7537fd19743f94156d995211819b41d792e5ae.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Paint Your World - No Mistakes, Just Happy Accidents[/b][/h1]
Now you can go around, sampling textures from any map you visit and adding them to your texture palette.  Then you can use your texture palette to repaint any surface in any of your arcades! :)

This feature was developed all last week thanks to suggestions & input from various Discord users!  A special thanks to Howie Duhzit, who dug around in the Source engine to find the mat_crosshair command and other techniques that led to this feature in AArcade!

Note that, for now, your paint job is local-only.  But in a future update, your custom paint jobs will also be synced when hosting your arcades!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/9be95939abf0f3661cac1708951a8d62aa2ed649.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]First Step - Add textures to your palette[/b][/h1]
Load up a map that has textures you like, look at a surface that has the texture, then go to the new Paint Tab on the Tab Menu and click Pick Texture.

[h1][b]Final Step - Paint using your palette[/b][/h1]
Now that you have a texture in your palette, you can look at any other surface, go to the new Paint Tab on the Tab Menu, and click on your texture in the list to apply it to the material under your crosshair!

[h1][b]Undo Paint / Unpaint[/b][/h1]
Want to unpaint a surface?  Look at the surface, then bring up the new Paint Tab on the Tab Menu and click the Reset Material button to undo any changes you made to the material & reset it back to its natural state.

[h1][b]Reset All Materials[/b][/h1]
Don't like your masterpiece and want to reset all the surfaces in your arcade back to their default?  To do this, look in the Commands Tab of the Tab Menu for a new command "Painted Materials Reset" that will restore all the materials in your current arcade instance to their natural state.  (Note that this button is in a different tab so that you don't accidentally click it while trying to paint.)

[h1][b]Custom Texture Palettes[/b][/h1]
You can have multiple custom texture palettes, very much like favorites lists.  So be sure to organize your textures onto palettes that make it easy for you to find the stuff you like!  I have one for Neon Retro Wave themed textures, and another for boring old regular architectural textures.

[h1][b]Texture Thumbnails[/b][/h1]
Until I am able to automate texture thumbnail generation perfectly, there is a button on the Paint Tab that lets you generate thumbnails for textures on-demand.  So textures show up as fully functioning generic placeholders by default, but you can give them thumbnails by clicking on their camera icon.

[h1][b]Prop & Displacement Painting Support[/b][/h1]
Some props will behave perfectly with the new painting feature.  Certain props might be hard to paint, as if your crosshair is not colliding with it.  In these cases, trying to find another more easily collidable instance of the prop can help.  Note that props that are truly non-collide cannot yet be easily painted or have their texture sampled.

If you are painting props that are [b]not[/b] part of the world map, and upon returning to the map it appears as if the props did not get their custom paint job applied, you may have to go to the new Paint Tab in the Tab Menu and click Re-Apply All after your arcade has loaded in.  (Note that this bug is due to the fact that only world textures get precached, while textures on props that you spawn get cached in on-the-fly.)

Displacements (ie. terrain) cannot be directly painted yet, but support for retexturing displacement surfaces will come in a future update!

[h1][b]ReShade Depth Support Improvements & Update[/b][/h1]
Today's AArcade update also brings the bundled ReShade up-to-date for everybody (including users who don't manually update it.)

Also, Discord user Howie Duhzit discovered an improvement to our default config that allows for proper ReShade depth effects.  His improvement has been integrated into the default config for AA's ReShade.

Again, I want to give a shout out to Wolfen for pressing the issue of AArcade's compatibility with ReShade, which lead to this support in the first place.

[h1][b]Want Faster AArcade Startup?[/b][/h1]
If you are one of the people who launch AArcade multiple times throughout the day, you'll probably want to cut down its startup times as much as possible.

Today's update adds a new way to do that to the General tab of the Settings menu with an option called "Auto Rebuild Sound Cache."  When you disable this, AArcade will skip the final step of starting up (Rebuilding Sound Cache), potentially cutting about 10 seconds off of your startup time, depending on how many addons you have.  Just note that this could impact addon maps' ability to play custom soundscapes.

Also in the General tab of Settings you can find and disable "Detect Maps When AArcade Starts," this will cache your detected addon maps instead of auto-detecting them each time AArcade starts, also potentially cutting 10+ seconds off of your startup time!

Or, you could be like me, and only launch AArcade once when Windows starts up and leave it going the whole time. :)  (Remember that AArcade has a highly optimized pause mode that releases its system resources.)

[h1][b]Dev Roadmap[/b][/h1]
A brief overview of the developments soon to come: inter-server teleports, a generic sit in chairs feature, in-game Steam Workshop consumption, custom map Steam Workshop publishing, VR compatibility improvements & comfort features, full Steam Workshop in-game arcade/object publishing support.

And, of course, tons of other fixes, improvements, and other new features that arise along the way.  I hope you've been having fun using your computer w/ AArcade, and I'll see ya'll in the metaverse!

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added a Paint Tab to the Tab Menu. Use it to retexture the materials in your instance how ever you wish.
[*] Added Painted Materials Reset to the Commands Tab.  Use it when you want to reset ALL of the painted materials in your instance.
[*] Added console commands "paint" which paints the material under your crosshair with the last used texture, "pick_texture" which changes the texture to use to the one under your crosshair, and "unpaint" which removes any modified textures on the material under your crosshair.
[*] Added the console command "repaint", which will re-apply all material modifications.  Useful for props that didn't load in until AFTER map load to get their material modifications applied.  (Until I can devise a good automatic solution for this.)
[*] Added the bool convar autobuildsoundcache 1.  When disabled, it will decrease startup times as the risk of custom sounds failing to play in addon maps.
[*] Fixed ReShade preprocessor definitions for ideal depth effects.  (Thanks to Discord user Howie Duhzit for sharing the proper settings!)[/list]

notes.title: Launcher & Shaders - Client Update 5/21/2019
notes.content:
Good afternoon metaversers!  Today's update is somewhat of a maintenance update, as it's purpose is to improve support with the popular ReShade.

If you have any questions about AArcade or how to get it working, you are welcome to join our community Discord at https://discord.gg/9FSCDuJ .

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/fac730c416fb070abcee92e6fb9afc945015c027.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Advanced Post Processing Shaders[/h1][/b]
Does your beefy PC have extra cycles to spare?  Do you want to make your arcades look heavenly with high quality bloom, depth of field, and other advanced & highly customizable post processing effects?  Well then ReShade is right for you.

ReShade is a popular graphics mod that allows you to add pretty post-processing effects to **tons** of already existing games.  A couple weeks ago AArcade users reported that using ReShade with AArcade was more difficult than it should have been, so today's update is about making it easy to use ReShade w/ AArcade.

[i]Please note that ReShade is an independent open source project and does not endorse nor is partnered with AArcade in any way.[/i]

[b][h1]New Launcher[/h1][/b]
The first thing you'll notice is the new launcher.  It's very similar to the old launcher, but now includes some extra options for you to set regarding ReShade.  This is where you'll go to enable ReShade for use in-game.

[b][h1]Post-Processing Bug[/h1][/b]
If you choose to use ReShade w/ AArcade, please note that you will have to [b]manually[/b] toggle off ReShade effects when you pause AArcade by pressing SCROLL LOCK (default).

notes.title: Wizards, Cabinets, & More - Client Update 5/12/2019
notes.content:
Hello! Today's update adds in some new cabinets & props, some fun new commands, improves support for local MP3 files, and adds support for Steam Friend invites.

To showcase the new assets, I made a short YouTube video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v-PR0LTa1Ns

[h1][b]Slim, Starfighter, Omni's, Holo's[/b][/h1]
There's 2 new arcade cabinets for housing games, and 3 new hologram/blend/sprite cabinets for housing images.  The interesting thing about the Hologram & Blends are that they use black as the alpha channel, so it looks great even on images without their own transparency!  Special thanks to OkeDoke for contributing the Starfighter cabinet!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/2b5f52d695abc6f296332246709220fd02fb5f89.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Physics (ie. rage mode)[/b][/h1]
There's a new button in the Object Context Menu, and also in the Commands tab, that temporarily toggles physics on objects in your arcade.  Feel free to wreck your arcades like a rock star in a hotel room!  Because when you reload the map, they are back in their original positions.  Party on!

[h1][b]Scaled To Fit[/b][/h1]
You can now stand on scaled objects and click on them just as well as you can regular objects!  So feel free to scale those tablets to fit right into the perfect space. :ily:

[h1][b]Wizards, Ani![/b][/h1]
There were 4 requests for new wizards for various users' favorite sites, so today's update includes 4 new wizards!  Soundcloud, Vesta, Itch.io's HTML5 games section, and DC Online are now all spawnable from wizards.

In addition to that, community member Mexc has contributed a new kind of wizard in today's update that takes all of the playlists on a YouTube channel profile and puts them in their own favorites list inside of AArcade!

To help keep users informed of how to use wizards, and what to expect from each one, I have started a Trello card that will detail each one.  It can be found here: https://trello.com/c/T7U9915u/1997-wizards-working-broken-list

[h1][b]Mirror Everything[/b][/h1]
If you hold down TAB and go to the Commands tab, you'll find a new button called Mirror Everything.  Pressing this temporarily turns *every single screen in your arcade* into a video mirror for some truely insane video watching.  Give it a try!  And just click the button again to turn it off. :)

[h1][b]Steam Invites[/b][/h1]
When you are in a multiplayer session, your friends will now be able to join you through Steam Friends!  The old invite links and regular Servers menu still work also.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/b418f7ea3dcf81dc2fb953f8b7023dc2b4cc38a1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]MP3 Auto-Playlist[/b][/h1]
When you spawn local MP3's onto the wall, they will now automatically play after you select them! Also, the other MP3 files in the same folder automatically play in a sequence too!

[h1][b]Refresh Textures[/b][/h1]
This is more of an advanced feature, but there's now various ways to refresh your textures in-game!  There's a Refresh Textures button on the Object Context Menu and if you click it once, it does a quick game-texture refresh.  Alternatively, if you click & hold on it, it'll clear your cache and re-download the image from the original source!  And if all else fails, there's a new console command called reset_image_loader that will reboot just the image loader without having to re-load the map.  More stability & improvements to come!

That's the main stuff for this update!  I'm still working on getting the VR build stable & into your hands, so stay tunned for news on when I squash the remaining bugs there.  Until then, I'll see you guys in the metaverse!

notes.title: Chat Menu Avatars & Global Achievements - Client Update 4/9/2019
notes.content:

It also has a bunch of important bug fixes, such as an update to the wizard for TheMovieDb.org, a bug that caused some SP arcades to only partially load, and a bug that caused local images to fail in the UI menus.

There are 2 upcoming major AA features to come in an update soon: the first is nodes & hubs, and the second is restored VR support.  There's been a lot of progress towards these 2 big features, but today's update has a lot of important bug fixes, so I've pushed these 2 big features back until the *next* update.

notes.title: Special Fx - Client Update 1/10/2019
notes.content:
Today's update adds some flashy light show & particle fx along with a slew of bug fixes & some requested features.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/6d8587c38b05908cdc6cc99936fb8a7d9cb46425.png[/img]
I meticulously hand-crafted these new props to go along with the new special fx that each one provides.  Allow me to tell you about each one...

[h1][b]Lights That Dance[/b][/h1]
Audio-reactive effects respond to your system audio levels.  This means the intensity & color of lighting effects respond to your music.  Many of the new Stage Light props have this behavior, so be sure to have some music playing as you spawn them into your maps!

[h1][b]Smoke Out Fog Machine[/b][/h1]
What are fancy lighting fx without fog for them to pierce through?  A new Fog Machine prop has been added to your library.  The FogOff XP2000.  It automatically spawns a smoke volume around it.  Scale your fog machine to also scale the fog volume around it.  The fog machines can be a little picky/buggy about creating their smoke, but are already good enough to start using.


[url=https://i.gyazo.com/8847e7fdf378759cdcd06ace51c83d8f.gif][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/50c112b2ba72631cf230bcade01764d658f9939e.jpg[/img][/url]
(Screenshot taken on an addon map, but notice the sage lights & smoke effects.)

[h1][b]Projectors[/b][/h1]
You'll also find 2 new projector props in your library.  These props will project what ever you are watching onto the wall in front of them, just like a video mirror.  Note that good quality shadows only happen for the 1st projector you spawn into your map, so use them wisely!

[url=https://i.gyazo.com/b50579e5dbf37dbad38b360674d6e65a.gif][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/623422986476152d0c95ac7e703c58c2b5549349.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Adopt-A-Prop[/b][/h1]
This new advanced feature is closely related to the upcoming Steam Workshop support soon to return to AArcade.  The Adopt button makes an extra copy of the selected model & all of its related assets into your aarcade_user/custom/adopted folder for safekeeping, OR to make it easier for you to share your model.  Use the adopt button to cherry-pick stuff you like from larger workshop subscriptions, or just to learn about what makes your favorite models tick.

Check the change log below for a list of all the other new stuff.

I hope you're having fun using your creations, and that these new special fx can showcase your collections better than ever before.  Be excellent to each other, & party on, dudes!

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added an Adopt Model button that makes a copy of the model & all of its assets into aarcade_user/custom/adopted.
[*] Added Projector & Projector Ceiling props to the default library.
[*] Added a Fog Machine prop to the default library.
[*] Added various Stage Light props to the default library.
[*] Added Object Shadows to the General tab of the Settings menu.
[*] Added drag & drop local file spawning. (Only 1-at-a-time for now.)
[*] Added drag & drop MDL spawning, if the MDL is in a valid engine folder. (Only 1-at-a-time for now.)
[*] Added Smoke Out to the Commands tab (F7).  It spawns a large temporary fog volume where ever you are standing.
[*] Added the ability to access your Favorites menu even as a guest in an MP server.  Note that, as a guest, the stuff that you spawn is local to you only.  Only the host is allowed to make changes that *ALL* players see.
[*] Added the convar projecto_fix 0, which can be used to disable some of the projector fixes for debug purposes.
[*] Added dev console output of the model's full absolute file path when you go to the Model Properties menu.
[*] Improved compatibility with Empires Mod addons and the cool new updates they are actively doing.
[*] Fixed Autoplay Nearby.
[*] Fixed the Stats & Achievements menu.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the NPC-related stats not to increment.
[*] Fixed all issues with spawnable projectors.
[*] Fixed importing all of your Steam games from your profile together.
[*] Fixed a but that caused the Spotlight Always On prop to leave its lighting effects behind after it was deleted.
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause "loopback error" to be printed to the console w/ the player frozen in place.
[*] Fixed breakable in-map objects & debris from them.[/list]

Note that updates that add new items to the default library take longer to launch the 1st time as it adds stuff to your library, but are fine as normal after that. :ily:

Note 2: At 9:36AM Pacific, I pushed a hot-fix so that object_shadows remains off by default, as it should.

And the last note: 12:28PM Pacific to *really* fix the object_shadows default value.

notes.title: Walls of Text + One Main Menu To Rule Them All - Client Update 10/16/2018
notes.content:
How do you do!  Today's update might be lacking on the spooky for this time of year, but it's still got some nice stuff in it.

[h1][b]Change - Yes we can.[/b][/h1]
While AArcade has tens of thousands of compatible addon props, I still want there to be a good selection of included props that people can use right out of the gate.  So I jumped on over to www.turbosquid.com and found an excellent change machine model for just $7.50, so I bought it, compiled it, and included it in today's update.  
[url=https://www.turbosquid.com/3d-models/pbr-ready---3d-model-1286589][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/86337e4603f9f8155ab64f35f7d7325d1c26121b.jpg[/img][/url]
If you like this, be sure to keep shooting me your donations, and I can, in turn, buy some more cool models from TurboSquid to include in the next update. :dealwithit:

I also want to give a shout out to Dekogon, the artist who made that model, just for being such a talented 3D artist & letting his work go for affordable prices.  Thanks for existing, guy! 

[h1][b]New Main Menu[/b][/h1]
Remember the old Main Menu?  Remember the Atlas?  Now they are one and the same.  The sleek new Main Menu looks nicer, is easier to use, is less confusing, and puts more useful information in front of you ftw.

[h1][b]Walls of Text[/b][/h1]
Now you can create text cards and spawn them into your arcades just like regular items!  To do it, just go to the Library Browser (EZ Mode), click on the new TEXT button there, type in some words and hit ENTER!  Then you can place your text into the map.

Not fancy enough?  No problem!  Just go to it's Item Properties menu to customize its font size, background color/image, border size, and much more to get it looking just like you want.

Text objects are multiplayer-compatible and even show their text when they aren't selected! :ily:

[h1][b]Arcade Heads-Up-Display[/b][/h1]
AArcade has context sensitive buttons.  That means that depending on what you are looking at in-game, the buttons might perform different actions.

Now there is an Arcade HUD that shows you what the important buttons will do at any given time!  This should help immensely with new users getting their feet on the ground with AArcade, but also might show seasoned AArcade veterans some common features they may have overlooked in the past.

Don't want the ugly Arcade HUD cluttering up your view?  No problem!  Just hit F1 to toggle it on-the-fly, or go into your settings to flip it off.  Either way gets you back to your clean HUD-free screen!

[h1][b]Chat Box & Free Mouse Mode[/b][/h1]
The Chat Box & Free Mouse Mode, both formally contained in the old Main Menu, are now moved into their own menus allowing them to be more streamlined & optimized.

You'll notice these menus now pop-up much faster than before and aren't cluttered with other stuff on them.  Hit the Y button to bring up the chat box.  Going into Free Mouse Mode depends on your settings, but for most people all you have to do is look at an empty spot in your arcade and hold down right-mouse button to be able to click on stuff with your mouse instead of aiming at them with your crosshair.

[h1][b]GET HYPE!!![/b][/h1]
The metaverse is real & now.  The digitization of human history, thought, knowledge, and activities has been accumulating since the dawn of the digital age.  The metaverse is real and encompasses all things, real & fiction, past & present.  As always, we reference things within the metaverse with links & shortcuts.  Meta data.  Anything, fact or fiction, historical or theoretical, and everything in between, can be represented by meta data in a shortcut.  This is the reality in which we currently live.

We are used to visualizing this metaverse as boring desktop shortcuts, menus, or lists of bookmarks.  Being thrown back into your Windows desktop between activities is what kills your immersion and forms your concept of what it's really like to use a PC.

This one aspect, what our shortcuts [b]look like[/b], is the laser focus of AArcade.  To increase the joy that you experience every time you use your PC, without interfering with the reality of how you use your PC.

So party on & enjoy yourself!  That's what AArcade is all about.  :ily:

[h1][b]NOTE[/b][/h1]
At 7:15am Pacific time I pushed an update to fix the missing texture on the new Arcade Hud.

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with videos not auto-playing when you select them.
[*] Added a new prop: Change Machine.
[*] Added a new arcade HUD that shows what context-sensitive buttons would do at any given time.
[*] Added F1 as a hotkey toggle the Arcade HUD. (You can also do this from the Settings menu.)
[*] Added a way to spawn text notes into your map.
[*] Added transparency support for GIFs and other image types to the image viewer. (Only useful when using the Hologram cabinet.)
[*] Added a new cabinet: Hologram.  It is a flat plane that displays your item.  When selected, it also supports transparency.
[*] Improved how AArcade treats YouTube radio lists (RD) differently than YouTUbe play lists (PL).
[*] Improved Free Mouse Mode to be more focused & optimized.
[*] Improved the Chat Menu (Y button) to be more focused & optimized.
[*] Fixed a bug with creating a new type from the Item Properties menu.
[*] Removed "Hide Social & Chat" and "24 Hour Clock" from the Settings menu because the new main menu makes them obsolete.[/list]

notes.title: 360 Degree Interactive Screenshots - Client Update 9/25/2018
notes.content:
[b]Introducing: 360 Interactive Screenshots![/b] They are the new 3rd option on the [b]F5[/b] screenshot menu.  These new screenshots let you look around & click on stuff to listen to music, watch videos, or launch Steam games right from your web browser!

Here's an example of what a 360 Interactive Screenshot is:
[url=http://anarchyarcade.com/2d/steamvrhomebeta2/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/cd954638799d94321c690cca3187cc97817aaaf2.jpg[/img][/url]

You can look around by dragging with your mouse, and you can click on stuff to watch it or access its shortcut.

360 Interactive Screenshots are very awesome, but unfortunately because WebGL doesn't let you load local files as textures, the new 360 interactive screenshots only work if you upload your screenshots to a web server.  But that's no problem for all you people who have a web server! :fallingman:

Here's some fixes, additions, and improvements in today's update as well.   [b]Hope you are all having a fun time in your worlds & I'll see you in the metaverse![/b] :ily:

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Improved the AArcade Launcher to be automatically bypassed unless you use the -config launch option.
[*] Added the ability for the featured servers to be rotated.  They will rotate once a week, for now.  Every Wednesday.
[*] Added support for creating 360 Interactive Screenshots.
[*] Added a way to refresh the cached achievement images stored for a Steam game's stickers.
[*] Added support for map-specific CFG files in cfg/map_name.cfg after loading a map.
[*] Added Select to the context menu.  It is useful for the rare cases when you want to select an object that has no collision mesh to click on.
[*] Added Look At Me to the context menu.  It causes the object to continually look at you, like a sprite.
[*] Added an "Advanced" section to the context menu that put the following commands into it: Autoplay, Export, Model, Look At Me, Select.
[*] Added Web Screenshot URL to the Main Menu > Settings > UI tab.  This is an advanced feature that lets users who plan to upload their interactive screenshots to their web server to specify the URL of the web folder they will be hosting the images at.  This allows proper META tags to be generated in their screenshots, which makes them look very nice when shared in chat applications like Discord or Steam PMs.

notes.title: Mario 64-Style Magic Paintings - Client Update 7/31/2018
notes.content:
A geotag is when a photo has detailed information embedded into it that shows exactly where it was taken.  Screenshots in AArcade are very much like this.  They remember what map you were on, where you were standing, and even what instance & server you were on when you took your screenshot.

Today's update adds the ability to spawn your screenshots right into your arcades as objects.  Screenshot objects behave just like the Map Transition doors in the meta_ maps!

Just walk up to one and press E to "use" it and you'll be able to travel directly to the spot that the screenshot shows!

Think of them like the Mario 64 paintings: jump into them to load the map shown in the picture.  Except you press E on them in AArcade instead. :D

[h1][b]How To Spawn Screenshot[/b][/h1]
When you hover over screenshots in the Maps > All Maps menu there will be a new icon that looks like a chess pawn.  Click it to spawn that screenshot into your arcade!  Note that screenshots you've previously spawned can be found in your library under the "maps" type.

[h1][b]Using Screenshot Objects[/b][/h1]
You have to press E (USE) on the screenshot object to use it as a teleport.  This will bring up the Map Transition menu just like the doors do in the meta_ maps.

[h1][b]AArcade Steam Community[/b][/h1]
Sure, the latest Steam client update may have broken the Steamworks API a little, but it also introduced an amazing new Discord-style Steam Community Group Chat feature!  If you like to be on the bleeding edge of new social platforms, feel free to join the AArcade Steam Community Group Chat by using this link: https://s.team/chat/DP7mOO2x

[h1][b]Ancient Stuff (Twitch & Discord)[/b][/h1]
Discord is [b]so[/b] last year, but it still remains the most popular chat platform I know of, so if you want to get in contact with me or other AArcade users feel free to drop into the Discord: https://discord.gg/8cxtuKY
Or if you'd rather lurk me during my live Twitch streams: http://www.twitch.tv/AnarchyArcade

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added the ability to spawn screenshots as objects.
[*] Added Wait For Initial Images To Load to the General tab of the Settings menu.  When it is enabled, the Loading Instance menu will remain up until all initial images are also loaded.
[*] Added a wizard for Wallpaper Cave.  Remember that you can hide wizards that you don't care about using the Wizards tab of the Advanced Library Browser.
[*] Improved screenshots to also create full resolution JPEG images.
[*] Improved teleporting to screenshots to also set your camera pitch.
[*] Improved the Loading Instance menu to use a full resolution screenshot, when available.[/list]

[h1][b]NOTE[/b][/h1]
Pressing E to "use" a screenshot object only works if the object is its original un-scaled size!  I'll be fixing this bug in the future, but for now just be sure not to scale your screenshots when you spawn them into your arcades. :ily:

[h1][b]NOTE 2[/b][/h1]
You may have noticed that the latest Steam client update broke web page pop-ups in AArcade, including a few of the wizards that depended on pop-ups like DuckDuckGo Images and Bing Images.  Please be patient while I try to get Valve's attention about the bug they re-introduced with the Steam client update.  It's actually one they've briefly introduced & fixed before, so hopefully it will be as easy for them to fix it again this time around.  Sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Persistent Servers - Client Update 5/25/2018
notes.content:
Today's update adds the very chill multiplayer feature of being able to host your arcade in PERSISTENT mode so your arcade can remain available to others even after you disconnect & turn off your PC.

Normally when you disconnect from a server that you are hosting, it is removed from the cloud and all of your guests get kicked to the Main Menu.  This is great for temporary servers, but it also means that your arcade is only open for business while you are actively connected.

Advanced users who want to keep their arcades up 24/7 can now host their arcade in the new PERSISTENT mode.  This keeps your arcade live & open for visitors in the cloud even after you disconnect & shut down your PC.

If you want to update one of your existing arcades that you hosted in persistent mode, simply go and re-host that same arcade again.  It will be replaced with your new version.

You can shutdown your existing persistent arcades by going to the Mutliplayer > Servers menu.

Cheers!

Today's update adds [b]audio-responsive Double Rainbow Mode[/b] and [b]Twitch chat support[/b] to AArcade.

[h1][b]Twitch Chat Support + Twitch Bot Commands[/b][/h1]
Now you can talk to the Twitch streams you watch or your own Twitch viewers.  There are also 2 new Twitch Bot Commands you can enable in the Twitch tab of the Settings menu.  You'll have to head there first to setup your Twitch info.  Press the Y button to bring up the chat menu while walking around a world.

[h1][b]Double Rainbow!!![/b][/h1]
Double Rainbow Mode can be enabled by holding down TAB and choosing it from the Commands tab.  Every screen's reflections will flash a HUE-rotating rainbow that lights up according to your system audio output.  You can further configure it in the UI tab of the Settings menu.  It's called Audio Visualization Reflections (AVS).

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added Double Rainbow Mode to the Commands menu.
[*]  Added Audio Visualization Reflections to the UI tab of the Settings menu.  It allows you to turn the screen reflections into a light show that reacts to your system audio level.
[*]  Improved the Chat menu to update in real-time and behave more like a chat room.
[*]  Added a Twitch tab to the Settings menu.
[*]  Added Twitch chat support to the Chat menu (press Y while walking around to open the Chat menu.) You must first go to the Twitch tab of the Settings menu to configure it.
[*]  Added Allow Twitch Bot Commands to the Twitch tab of the Settings menu.  Enable it to allow your own Twitch viewers to use commands like !map to see what map you are currently on or !linx to see the title & URL of item you are watching.[/list]

[b]Note[/b]

notes.title: Cabinets, Props, & Thumbnails - Client Update 4/5/18
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/58920a738bf21bd8ed6de783f8cecbe1f44ddc3a.png[/img]

[h1][b]New Cabinets & Props[/b][/h1]
Today's update includes 4 community-favorite cabinet models now bundled with Redux.  First there's the Curved Big Screen & Blaster cabinets created by Oke_Doke, and then there's the Revenge & Space cabinets created by the collaborative efforts of Oke_Doke & Invict.  Now included with Redux for new players to enjoy out-of-the-box!

There are also 6 new props included with today's update that were previously 
only available as addons.  These include the Dance Pad, Big Speaker, Weight Set, Bowl Lamp, Party Hat, and, of course, the Beer.

[h1][b]Default & Manual Prop Thumbnails[/b][/h1]
Thumbnail images can now be set for props, making your favorite stuff easier to spot in the spawn menu.  All the default models have thumbnails already too!  And you can manually set what ever images you want for your addon models.

[h1][b]Social Mode Improvements[/b][/h1]
With today's update, there are now chat logs of what people have said in your session!  No more speed reading or wondering if you've missed something! :D

You press the Y button to open up chat while walking around your arcade.  HINT: If you are opted into "Social Mode", you'll be able to talk to people that are even in other sessions!

Also, the Social Mode chat box will now show you a list of online users so you know who's in the room with you!

[h1][b]Player Model Morphing[/b][/h1]
You can now morph into any model you're looking at by holding down TAB and going to Commands to use the new Player Model Morph command!  Not all models will animate properly, but some will be fully rigged & working.  If you turn into something dumb, you can use the new Player Model Reset command to fix yourself!

[h1][b]AArcade Community[/b][/h1]
If you're interested in joining the social side of the AArcade user community, you can join us in Discord ( https://discord.gg/Nshzn2q ) or lurk one of my Twitch streams ( http://www.twitch.tv/AnarchyArcade ).  Until the next update, party on ya'll!

[*] Added Player Model Morph / Player Model Reset to the Commands menu.
[*] Added a list of your favorite items & props to the EZ Library Browser.
[*] Added a Launch button to the Advanced Context Menu.
[*] Added Wizards to the Advanced Context Menu.

notes.title: Skee-Ball Prop, Tiny Mode, & Social Mode - Client Update 4/1/2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/e6fe347bcfd09028d10de673d60714e01c640b32.png[/img]
[h1][b]Skee-Ball[/b][/h1]
The classic skee-ball prop is now included among your props!  You can search search your Advanced Library Browser for "Skee" to find it in your props.

[h1][b]Tiny Mode (+more new commands)[/b][/h1]
Tiny Mode makes you about 2 inches tall.  A couple screen overlay effects & some other goodies have been added to the Commands Menu.  Just hold down TAB to access the Commands Menu.

[h1][b]Social Mode[/b][/h1]
Checking the Social Mode checkbox on your Main Menu will allow you to chat with other AArcade users even if they are not in your session.  This will make it easier to see how many people are online & interested in socializing, plus let you talk to them to organize games.  You press the Y button to open your chat box.

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added Social Mode as a checkbox on the Main Menu.  Users who are in Social Mode can all talk to each other even if they are not in a session together.
[*] Added tabs to the Chat Menu so you can choose to send your chat to only the people in your lobby, or to all the users in social.
[*] Added the following to the Commands tab of the Tab Menu: Tiny Mode/Tiny Mode Reset, Black & White Mode, Overlay Combine Vision/Overlay Reset, Camera 1st/3rd Person, All Guns Off.
[*] Added a Wizards tab to the Advanced Library Browser.
[*] Added the ability to hide wizards.
[*] Added Skee-Ball prop to the default library.
[*] Added a Debug Info button onto Source engine menu for beta testers to help track down a bug.
[*] Improved multiplayer mode to sync head pitch too.
[*] Improved accuracy of all sliders in the Transform Menu while placing objects.
[*] Improved the Continuous Play button to use what ever item you're looking at (IF you don't have one selected already.)
[*] Improved AArcade's stability when exiting multiplayer sessions in non-conventional ways as a client.
[*] Improved the DuckDuckGo Images & Bing Images scrapers to automatically change https addresses to http instead.
[*] Improved Auto Save to purge newly created library entries when discarding changes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused chat messages to be hidden when event notifications were disabled.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused AArcade to not properly pause when launching shortcuts from the middle-click menu.
[*] Fixed a bug that causes in-game tasks to close when props were selected / deselected.
[*] Fix an issue that causes AArcade to attempt to load arcades on maps that you have since deleted.
[*] Fixed a purple checkerboard texture that would appear when viewing newly created web tabs in fullscreen mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where guests of your arcade didn't have avatars.
[*] Reduced the reflection intensity on the screen & marquee materials.
[*] Hid the node, missing, & teleport models in cabinet select lists because they aren't useful.
[*] Removed the Scrapers button from the Advanced Library Browser because there is a Wizards tab now.[/list]

[h1]NOTE[/h1]
I pushed a hotfix at 9:46PM Pacific time so that the Skee-Ball prop would properly be added to everybody's library.

notes.title: Fixed Maps + Source Engine Game Launching - Client Update 3/27/2018
notes.content:
Today's update fixes the issues with meta_hood, oververse, hub_highrise, sm_acreage, and Dralloc's new map dralloc_gallery!  You'll also be able to launch other Source engine games from AArcade as expected, such as L4D2 or CSGO!

[list][*] Added the new DraLLoC map, dralloc_gallery.
[*] Added a new world called Meta Flats as the default in the Worlds tab of the Maps menu. It has the 5 new meta_ maps in it.

[*] Change the default color scheme to Windows Wannabe (blue).
[*] Renamed Starter Land to Old Town in the Worlds tab of the Maps menu.
[*] Removed the "Reload UI Page" little white dot from the top-right corner of all UI menus.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the counts on the Tab menu to be incorrect.
[*] Fix an issue that caused the previous UI menu to show for a split second when loading up a new UI menu.
[*] Fixed issues with the following maps: meta_hood, oververse, hub_highrise, sm_acreage.

[h1][b]NOTE 2[/b][/h1]
At 8:05 AM Pacific, I pushed a hotfix that corrected some issues in meta_haze & meta_zen.

notes.title: Prop Animations + New NPCs, Cabinets, & Map - Client Update 3/24/2018
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/128bd578842510f28423315ed57be5adc8a54456.png[/img]

Lots of exciting new content & features in today's update!

[h1][b]New Map[/b][/h1]
You can find the new map by going to Main Menu > Maps and searching for Dralloc.  (NOTE: This map is currently delayed while we make some last-minute optimizations to it!)

[h1][b]New Cabinets[/b][/h1]
The new cabinets will be in your Transform Menu when spawning shortcuts.  They are the Record Plaque, Record Sleeve, and Record w/ Sleeve, DVD Case, and Flatscreen TV Wall.

[h1][b]New NPC Props[/b][/h1]
The new NPC props can be found in your Advanced Library Browser's Props tab by searching for their names: Hacker Haley, Ninja Nancy, Cowboy Carl, Fit Frank, & Zombie Joe!

[h1][b]New Animation Menu[/b][/h1]
Props that support animation will list all their available sequences in the new Animation tab of the Transform Menu when spawning them.

[h1][b]Have Fun![/b][/h1]
I found myself spawning all 5 of the new NPCs in every one of my old arcades that I loaded up, which was a lot of fun!  Also, many addon player models can now be posed using the Animation tab for even more character companions!  If you have any questions, need help with anything, or just want to get in contact with me or the rest of the AArcade community, feel free to join us in Discord at https://discord.gg/Nshzn2q or drop into one of my live Twitch streams at http://www.twitch.tv/AnarchyArcade.  Party on, dudes!

[h1][b]Shout-Outs[/b][/h1]
AArcade's development is guided by user feedback.  Most of the updates are in response to feedback, requests, & suggestions given to me by users in the Discord, the Twitch, or in Steam PMs.

I just want to recognize Wolfen for his latest requests for prop animation, autoplaying items, and some others that I've already implemented from him in the past couple weeks.  N00bVader for suggesting the vinyl record music cabinets, Pux420 for requesting the DVD Case cabinet, and all the other great testers & users who have been feeding me bug reports, feedback, & suggestions to help guide my development of this project over the years.  Thanks ya'll!

[h1][b]Change Log[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added the ability to animate props.
[*] Added an animation sequence selector to the Transform Menu for props.
[*] Added 5 animated human NPC props for you to spawn in your arcades: Ninja Nancy, Hacker Haley, Cowboy Carl, Fit Frank, and Zombie Joe.
[*] Added another new map named dralloc_gallery, created by DraLLoC, the author of classic maps such as Party Cabin (sm_acreage) and Nightclub (sm_primo).
[*] Added the following cabinets: DVD Case, Flatscreen TV Wall, Record Plaque, Record w/ Sleeve, Record Sleeve.
[*] Added thumbnail images for all remaining default cabinets & many popular addon cabinets.
[*] Added cabinet category tabs to the Transform Menu for quickly finding the cabinet you want.
[*] Removed the DVD case from the default Tabletop TV cabinet.
[*] AArcade will now automatically (re)add all default library entries after a new client update (so the update's new stuff will be in your library automatically.)
[*] Fixed an issue that caused AArcade to crash-to-desktop when spawning certain scaled models while Scale Collisions was active.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Source Engine Options button in the Options menu.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed props to be set to autoplay.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from searching from the Main Menu unless you had favorites already.

notes.title: Client Update 12/21/2017
notes.content:
[h1][b]Stickers[/b][/h1]
These are little pre-made PNGs that you can stick onto your items' marquee images however you want!  There's only a handful of PNGs to choose from right now, but more will be added soon.

The sticker system was created so we'd have something to give users as rewards for earning AArcade achievements.  The idea is that most of them would start off locked, and you'd get to choose which ones you want to unlock as you earn AArcade achievements.

Note that all the stickers are un-locked by default for now, until the stats & achievements are fully implemented.

[list][*] Added a Stickers tab to the Edit Item menu where you can apply stickers onto your item's marquee image.
[*] Fixed cabinet & prop animations.
[*] Improved texture filtering on all dynamic textures.
[*] Removed purple checkerboard that showed when selecting an object.
[*] Fixed the Show Windows Taskbar option to work again.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Windows taskbar to remain on-top when it shouldn't have.
[*] Partially fixed projector props.[/list]

[h1][b]NOTE[/b][/h1]
At 9:52am Pacific time I pushed a hotfix because I forgot to include the updated DLLs.  All should be working now! ːilyː

notes.title: Client Update 12/5/2017
notes.content:
Today's AArcade update brings a significant improvement to how you interact with AArcade!

In addition to the Free-Look-Mode that we are used to when walking around our arcades, today's update brings us Free-Mouse-Mode, which freezes our camera in-place and allows us to freely move our mouse to click on stuff.

AArcade's Main Menu has been revamped to take full advantage of Free-Mouse-Mode.  It now feels a lot like your Windows task bar, but lists all of your in-game tasks instead.

Also noteworthy in this update is the ability for AArcade to display your actual Windows task bar while in Free-Mouse-Mode, making it easy to see what you have open both inside of AArcade & in Windows itself.

And finally, this update adds a "YouTube End Behavior" option to the Settings menu that lets you choose what happens when a YouTube video ends.  Most notably, you can set it to "Play Next Nearby Video", which essential turns every YouTube video in your arcade into a geographically sorted playlist.

Thanks everybody for your patients as AArcade evolves!  If you experience any annoyances related to the UI changes in this update, please let me know about them in the AArcade Discord (https://discord.gg/Nshzn2q) or on my personal Twitch stream (http://www.twitch.tv/AnarchyArcade).  Enjoy your gaming!

[h1][b]AArcade: Source[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added Free-Mouse-Mode (replaced the old Main Menu.)
[*] Improved Free-Look-Mode.
[*] Fixed task thumbnails in the Task Menu.
[*] Fixed loading maps from the Worlds tab of the Play menu.
[*] Changed HUD notifications to be OFF by default.
[*] Renamed the Options menu to the Settings menu (to parody Windows.)
[*] Added "YouTube End Behavior" option to the UI tab of the Settings menu.
[*] Added "Show Windows Task Bar" option to the UI tab of the Settings menu.
[*] Improved object glows to be more distinguishable.
[*] Screen mirrors now show the most recently "focused" in-game task on them.
[*] Holding right-mouse sends mouse input to any active in-game screen you are looking at.  Holding right-mouse while not looking at an active in-game screen will toggle you in/out of Free-Mouse-Mode/Free-Look-Mode while you hold it down.[/list]

[b]NOTE[/b]
If you have your regular Windows task bar positioned somewhere other than the bottom of your screen, you'll want to turn off "Show Windows Task Bar" in AArcade's options until I add a way for you to also re-position IT as well.

[b]NOTE 2[/b]
A hotfix for this update was pushed at 6:16am Pacific time to allow the new Main Menu to work even when no map is loaded.

notes.title: Client Update 10/28/2017
notes.content:
Today's update allows your friends to join you in their web browser & explore your arcade with you!  I'm hoping to have Redux finished by the end of December!

As always, feel free to ask me for help if you need it.  The Discord is the best way to contact me & other AArcade users for a quick response: https://discord.gg/Nshzn2q

[h1][b]Multiplayer Instructions:[/b][/h1]
[olist][*] Load up any of your arcades in singleplayer.
[*] Click HOST on the Main Menu.
[*] Invite your friends with the URL it gives you. (They join you in top-down 2D mode using their web browser.)[/olist]

Note that in-game multiplayer will be coming soon as well!

[h1][b]Change Log:[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added the Main Menu > Host menu.
[*] Added the Main Menu > Online menu.
[*] Added a Disconnect button to the Main Menu.
[*] Added 360 panoramic screenshots for multiplayer sessions.
[*] Added embedded overview map support for Counter-Strike: Source maps in multiplayer sessions.
[*] Increased the max FOV to 200.
[*] Fixed an issue with broken maps being auto-reloaded.
[*] Fixed Automatic Desktop Size in the launcher to actually work.
[*] Changed AArcade to launch without a window border by default.
[*] Added buttons next to Type & App lists to edit them or add new ones.
[*] Changed the MDL file in the Model Properties menu to be readonly.
[*] Improved the reliability of props remembering their offsets & rotation.
[*] Added Use Transparency When Moving Objects to the General tab of the Options menu.
[*] Improved fullscreen image viewing to only auto-scroll if the image is significantly different than the browser aspect ratio.
[*] Added Toggle Libretro to the Commands tab of the Main Menu.
[*] Added error messages for various known (and fixable) launch failures.

notes.title: Redux Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everybody! I hope you've been enjoying the Redux beta of AArcade. Today's article is to update you on how Redux's development is progressing, and to get you all ready for AArcade coming out of early access at the end of this year.  So start things off, I'll give a very brief explanation of how AArcade has evolved up to this point.

[b]But first I want to let everybody know about the AArcade Discord where you can talk to me & other AArcade users live at: https://discord.gg/8cxtuKY[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/bf0463bd3bae47fff09a0308546789471d795da4.png[/img]
[h1][b]AArcade's Purpose[/b][/h1]
The core purpose of AArcade is to launch your applications & turn your desktop into a 3D world, without hindering your normal use of Windows.  Fulfilling this unique purpose is the reason why AArcade exists.  And I'm happy to say, even after being around for all these years, it's still filling the niche very nicely.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/52089a9e31b2a14122ccc551062f93d7d5e2eabb.png[/img]
[h1][b]Evolution of AArcade[/b][/h1]
AArcade has been around for about 7 years.  The old prototype, called Legacy version, was already starting to show its age even before its release.  It was limited to a very old web browser which failed to work well even on sites like YouTube, and it looked like the issues were just gonna get worse as the years continue to pass by.

AArcade is something its users have used for years, and will continue to use for years to come.  So in order to ensure that AArcade continues to be capable of providing us with the modern experiences we desire, a *complete* & more versatile design overhaul of the prototype was required.  So the old prototype was preserved as the Legacy version, while this completely overhauled build is called the new Redux version.

Redux is like AArcade 2.0.  It aims to do the exact same thing as Legacy version, but do it better, be easier to use, and have less bugs.  It also is backward compatible with our Legacy stuff, so we don't lose the arcades we've already been using for years.

And that's where Redux development is at right now.  I'm in the process of making the Redux version have all the same features as Legacy version.  In addition, Redux also has a lot of other highly requested improvements that were just not possible before in the old Legacy version.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j3XfJcfeD4Q
[h1][b]Redux Development Progress[/b][/h1]
Instead of just summarizing [i]recent[/i] development, I'll break down the progress into 5 major feature categories. Redux is trying to do everything Legacy does in these feature categories.  Redux is also able to add great improvements to nearly all of these feature categories that were not possible before in Legacy's design, along with many bug fixes.  Keep in mind that certain features might only become useful when they reach 100%.  Also, some features need to be implemented [i]after[/i] other features that they depend on.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/4da0665c00ce8c89aa1bc3f12c45998cc6d77aa1.png[/img]
[h1]Source Engine Sandbox[/h1]
[b]Progress (90%)[/b]
[list][*] Compatible Source engine games are [b]automatically[/b] detected & mounted, if they are installed.
[*] Searchable prop & item library w/ a complete set of [b]on-screen[/b] transform tools.
[*] Unlimited amount of save instances per-map.
[*] Backward compatible with (most) Legacy saves & content.
[*] Screenshots work as teleport destinations.
[*] On-screen menu of fun & useful cheats/commands.
[*] Quick Load allows you to return to the most recent instance & location that you used on a map without having to choose from a menu.
[*] Firstperson or thirdperson mode w/ customizable camera options.[/list]

[b]Pending[/b]
[list][*] Can't add MDL files as props from the Windows File Browse dialogue yet.
[*] Can't bulk "Detect All Models" to scan for new MDL files as props yet.
[*] Can't detect new workshop subscriptions during runtime yet.
[*] Can't bulk "Detect All Maps" to scan for new BSP files during runtime yet.
[*] Can't create & publish new workshop shares from Redux yet.
[*] Redux needs to be improved to properly use the older "gen 1" legacy workshop content.
[*] Nodes (which are physical clusters of objects) don't work yet.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/aae7e3a689aac28f18106ec7e323f33547fe393a.png[/img]
[h1]3D Desktop[/h1]
[b]Progress (90%)[/b]
[list][*] Versatile shortcut library to easily manage, search, spawn, or launch shortcuts even for people with huge collections.
[*] Launches any shortcut that Windows can launch.
[*] Launches Steam games, Origin games, Oculus Home games, everything.
[*] Soft-pause to reduce performance impact w/o a long delay upon returning to AArcade.
[*] Borderless window mode for continued regular use of your Windows operating system.
[*] Open-with style of apps are supported w/ customizable launch option syntax.[/list]

[b]Pending[/b]
[list][*] Doesn't have hard-pause yet, where AArcade optimizes performance impact but also causes a moderate delay when returning to AArcade. (This pause mode is *required* to launch other Source 1 engine games.)
[*] Can't launch other Source 1 engine games yet, like L4D2 or Counter-Strike: Source.
[*] Can't launch AArcade once & leave it open all day yet because it has to be closed to launch other Source 1 engine games still.
[*] The menus for creating new open-with apps & customizing them haven't been made yet.  Only open-with apps that were imported from Legacy work so far.
[*] The instructions on how to create addon JavaScript meta scrapers are not included yet.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/71176d5bf65ef041654298d5756c71af51edba9e.png[/img]
[h1]Embedded Frameworks[/h1]
[b]Progress (80%)[/b]
[list][*] Steam Client WebHelper to provide a modern Chromium web browsing experience directly on the in-game screens with a web browser maintained by Valve themselves as part of the Steamworks SDK.  Works perfectly on nearly all sites, but does not support WebGL or Adobe Flash.
[*] Awesomium framework to power AArcade's interactive menus & user interface that often gets layered on top of a web tab or other embedded framework.
[*] Libretro framework to allow the many compatible homebrew, app, & emulator cores to render directly to the in-game screens.  Complete with a comprehensive set of dynamic menus to allow access to the many features of Libretro.
[*] All embeded frameworks are no longer bound to in-game framerate.  That means no more sound stuttering, even if you're getting a bad framerate in the Source engine map itself.
[*] You can now have as many in-game web tabs open as you want, you aren't limited to just 2 anymore.  The framerate that your in-game web tabs render at is distributed among how ever many you have open, to provide the best experience.[/list]

[b]Pending[/b]
[list][*] Most of the Libretro features & menus are disabled for now, because they depend on the menus for creating & customizing open-with apps. Only the FFMPEG Libretro core is currently enabled.
[*] There isn't a button for switching between the Steam Client WebHelper & the Awesomium framework for displaying web pages.  The reason we want a button to switch is because the Awesomium browser, while very outdated & not very good, [b]does[/b] support Flash, while the Steam Client WebHelper browser does not.
[*] There's no on-screen UI for cores such as the FFMPEG core to adjust volume or skip around in a local video file yet.
[*] The in-game web tabs need a handful of multiplayer enhancements, such as syncing & visualizing everybody's pointer positions together and the option to sync URL changes in a web tab, if desired.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/d1894083c855b21235e3a396315e94854b89d42d.png[/img]
[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
[b]Progress (30%)[/b]
[list][*] A prototype of Redux's metaverse was already written. It was the first work that I did on Redux.
[*] Metaverse mode isn't very different from singleplayer mode.  It's fast to implement.[/list]

[b]Pending[/b]
[list][*] The prototype of Redux's metaverse needs to be updated & implemented.
[*] Redux's workshop support needs to be completed before multiplayer mode can be finished.
[*] Hosting your singleplayer arcades in multiplayer mode will be first.
[*] Persistent servers will come soon after that.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/978e2c01212e35b9d8fd2aac88b5c213577421cd.png[/img]
[h1]Virtual Reality[/h1]
[b]Progress (40%)[/b]
[list][*] HMD render fix w/ hand tracking exists, created by Marulu & HLVR team. (THIS IS HUGE!!)
[*] VR friendly in-world UI system.[/list]

[b]Pending[/b]
[list][*] The VR render fix is not yet fully implemented into Redux.
[*] There is no teleport system yet.
[*] No hand-interaction with physics objects yet.
[*] The selection pointer is not bound to your hand yet, still uses what you're looking at.
[*] Unknown if the VR fix will hinder AArcade's ability to launch VR games.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6721978/a5db5ac2cfe999c843b4aa80da558abee3bf1836.png[/img]
[h1][b]Release Date[/b][/h1]
I'm working to have AArcade Redux parody all of Legacy's features by Christmas, at which time AArcade will come out of Early Access some time around December 25, 2017.  I'll be able to give a more exact release date as the end of the year approaches.  (You never know if development might go faster than expected.)

AArcade is something its users have used for years, and will continue to use for years to come. Redux allows for development tasks ranging from minor maintenance, all the way to major improvements, such as additional embedded frameworks, to be added with ease when ever the need may arise.  Thus, insuring that we will never be stuck out in the cold like we were with Legacy's aging web browser.

After AArcade comes out of early access, that's when my development effort will shift towards supporting the community with organization & events.  We will also be building our community multiplayer server together and watch the melting pot of personalities take physical shape right before our eyes, just as we saw with Legacy mode's community server.

There's no need to wait until December to jump in and start watching your own personal corner of the metaverse take shape around you though!  The latest Redux beta is always available in early access & already has most of the features to fulfill AArcade's core purpose of launching your applications & turning your desktop into a 3D world, without hindering your normal use of Windows!

And remember, if AArcade can't do it yet, screw AArcade!  Just do it normally in Windows!  AArcade's not the boss of you!

Until next time, I'll see you in the metaverse.  Talk to me live in the AArcade discord https://discord.gg/8cxtuKY or look me up on Twitch during a Wednesday http://www.twitch.tv/AnarchyArcade .  Party on!

notes.content:
Today's update is a few small new features & some bug fixes while I continue working on the bigger nodes & workshop updates that will be ready in a few more days.

[list][*] Added a WORLDS tab to the Play menu to easily choose from default maps.
[*] Added a PAUSE button to the Main Menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with Import All Steam Games that caused the Meta Scrape button not to appear.
[*] Added the option "AArcade Startup Behavior" which lets you tell AArcade to automatically load the most recent map after it starts up.
[*] Changed the hands/weapons & the HUD to be hidden by default (for new users).
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the "Show Hands/Weapons" & "Show HUD" options to be reset every time.
[*] Moved the following menus to the new UI template: Play, and Map Instances.
[*] Improved the Maps Menu to quick-load a map when you click its thumbnail directly.
[*] Added an "Instances" button to maps in the Map Menu so you can manually choose which instances/spawn position you want to use.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a weird broken cabinet to spawn at the map origin.
[/list]

notes.title: Client Update 6/6/2017
notes.content:
This is a special update.  The next time that you launch AArcade: Redux, it will take a little bit longer than you're used to as it updates your AArcade library with fixes.

It only needs to apply the fixes once.  After that, it'll start up fast like usual.

It automatically makes a backup of AArcade's library.db in case anything goes wrong.  But just be patient as it applies the fixes and it'll be all good.

[h1][b]Change Log:[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added a library updater so BETA users do **not** lose what they've built prior to this update.
[*]  New UI template on the following menus: Starting Up, Main Menu, Edit Object, Edit Item, Addons Menu, Embedded Apps, and the Import Menu.  (Soon to be added to the rest of the menus too!)
[*]  Improved startup sequence & progress bars.
[*]  Improved error & debug checking during workshop initialization.
[*]  Added Automatically Set Game Name to the Broadcast Mode options.
[*]  Added "Game Name" to the Broadcast Mode options.
[*]  Fixed an issue that made spaces not work in various fields of the options menu.
[*]  Fixed an issue that prevented Broadcast Mode from outputting to the correct folder.
[*]  Fixed Lappy (Elite Laptop) cabinet to be part of the default library.
[*]  Fixed Flatscreen TV cabinet to be part of the default library.
[*]  Fixed an issue that often resulted in large numbers of missing objects, items, or models, **especially** from Legacy mode or workshop saves. (See Note.)
[*]  Fixed an issue that caused the Room Divider & Newton Toy props to be listed as cabinets instead.
[*]  Improved Legacy Export to give the option of overwriting duplicates, improved its support for custom type names, retain legacy "group" names as "keywords", and retain the use of preview URLs on models.
[*]  Added the "aarcade_user/backups" folder where auto-backups of the user's library.db gets saved to before major maintenance operations.[/list]

[h1][b]NOTE[/b][/h1]
If your saves exported from Legacy Mode were missing large amounts of objects, or your custom type names were not exporting, you'll want to do these 2 things to fix it:

1. Launch Redux Mode once first, so it fixes up your library.db.
2. Close it & go export from Legacy Mode again.
3. Make sure that you tell it to overwrite existing duplicates for your instances!

Please be aware that re-exporting your legacy saves like this will revert any changes you've made to them in Redux.

Thank you for your patients as I work to get legacy content all fixed up!

[h1][b]UPDATE[/b][/h1]
This morning's update had a broken main menu.  At 11:41am Pacific time I pushed a hotfix that resolves the issue.  Your startup sequence & main menu should work as expected now.
